Synopsis:
    A Reuters market overview from September 2, 2026, covering the ripple effects of renewed Iranian conflict-driven energy price surges. Rising oil and gas prices are pushing global bond yields higher (US 10Y at 4.8%), triggering equity selloffs and increasing pressure on multiple central banks (Fed, ECB, BoJ) to hike rates this month. European governments face a politically sensitive budget season heading into winter, with surging gas prices — already at their highest since 2023 — compounding sovereign borrowing cost pressures across the continent. German state elections in September add further political complexity.
